selected-high-rank-freeze-pacify.head: 579527ca
selected-high-rank-freeze-pacify.scope: The stock client used both rank-3 Freeze System and rank-2 Freeze Area against selected hostile players, covering early refusals, the exact hostile area boundaries, timers, and matched effect removal. The 479 sample verified the live archived-value baseline and leaves the authored player magnitude unresolved.

controls.source: GOB 473 gives Pacify for 4 s, Viral Resistance -80 for 8 s and AddControlImmunityTimer for the independent 8 s protection. Effective Code adds 15% Pacify duration in the fixture.
controls.runtime: The timed state and linked resistance terminate together on damage, while the independent 734/681 immunity remains until its own expiry. Natural state expiry leaves the resistance until its 8 s term.
controls.test: SelectedHighRankPacifyRetainsTheSeparateNaturalStateAndImmunityExpiry and FreezeSystem473PacifiesAndAppliesItsViralVulnerability cover expiry, action blocking and damage break. PR931 stock receives Pacify 4.60 s, resistance -80 for 8 s, and independent immunity for 8 s; a second cast breaks its state and resistance on a landed Logic Blast for 17 while immunity runs from 01:07:15 to 01:07:23. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/931#issuecomment-7093037499

targeting.source: GOB 473 requires Hacker Style and a selected hostile within 12 m, with a viral contest and a target-centred 4 m radius.
targeting.runtime: AbilityHandler guards the original selected hostile and spawn from admission through landing; the common sight and viral contest paths qualify each candidate.
targeting.test: SelectedPacifyRefusesBeforeCostAndRetainsTheAdmittedSpawn exercises empty, out-of-range, blocked, unloaded and replaced selections. SelectedFieldUsesThePrimaryCentreAndEachRecipientOwnContest exercises independent defender contests. PR931 stock sends the selected request, gets refusal 24 for empty and ally and 34 at 12.01 m without cost or reuse, and affects only the selected hostile and the 4.00 m hostile edge. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/931#issuecomment-7093037499

479.note: The original 479 cast was NPC Radueriel against player RajkoHaxor. The retained MaraCThenTimeDOut archive names both actors at lines 60961–60962 and 61046–61050; 60996–60998 shows 85 for 10.02 s, 157 -100 for 12 s and 734/681 for 12 s. Lines 61459–61463 identify Radueriel's NPC_BASE creation as template 94030008. GOB 479 authors 6 s Pacify and resistance -80 for 12 s; PR931's ordinary player cast measured the existing NPC-derived duration 11.523001 s after +15%, and resistance -100. PR936 then verified the corrected player values and the natural and damage-break lifecycles. See the 479 evidence from that retest. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/blob/552aa727/research/packet-dumps/community-intake/20260607T191353Z-hdneo-public-combat-pvp-rajko-state-selected/logs/mxopackets2_RajkoPacketsNearTheEnd_PacketsMaraCThenTimeDOut.log.txt#L60961-L61050

area.source: GOB 479 uses selected target-centred hostile recipients with a 6 m radius.
area.runtime: The common hostile area selector uses the validated primary target's coordinates and filters the ally and recipients beyond the radius before their own viral contests.
area.test: SelectedFieldUsesThePrimaryCentreAndEachRecipientOwnContest exercises per-recipient landing. PR931 stock confirms effects only on the selected QAEnemy and the hostile exactly 6.00 m from it, with QAFar at 6.01 m and QAFriend excluded. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/931#issuecomment-7093037499

targeting.source: GOB 479 requires Hacker Style, a hostile selection within 14 m and an out-of-combat cast. The hostile landing path uses sight and a viral contest.
targeting.runtime: AbilityHandler validates admission and keeps the admitted hostile view and spawn until completion. The common sight and viral intent checks qualify each recipient separately.
targeting.test: SelectedPacifyRefusesBeforeCostAndRetainsTheAdmittedSpawn exercises ally, range, style, in-combat, and in-flight retreat branches. SelectedFieldUsesThePrimaryCentreAndEachRecipientOwnContest exercises independent defender contests. PR931 stock checks empty selection and an ally (24), 14.01 m range (34) without debit or timer, and the positive selected-hostile activation. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/931#issuecomment-7093037499

script.source: GOB 479 uses AddControlImmunityTimer. The archived NPC cast pairs Pacify with the distinct 734/681 immunity record for 12 s.
script.runtime: TimedEffects adds the independent 734/681 marker with its own duration and releases it independently of the Pacify state.
script.test: SelectedHighRankPacifyRetainsTheSeparateNaturalStateAndImmunityExpiry exercises independent natural expiry. PR931 stock records paired 734/681 application and removal twelve seconds apart on the two eligible hostiles. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/931#issuecomment-7093037499
